profile.headline: Solving problems and making things work!
profile.summary:
I’m a full stack software engineer and engineering leader with over 20 years of experience in the software industry, having grown from a foundation in QA and program management into a strong, pragmatic developer and team leader. My unique career path gives me a well-rounded understanding of the entire software development lifecycle—from initial planning through testing, delivery, and production support.

In recent years, I’ve led small teams and built scalable web applications using modern technologies like Ruby on Rails, .NET Core, AngularJS, and React. I’ve worked across backend, frontend, and infrastructure, often bridging the gap between product, design, and engineering to help teams ship high-quality software on time.

I bring a balanced approach to development—prioritizing business value, user experience, and code maintainability. Whether I’m mentoring junior developers, writing well-architected backend services, or refining team processes, my goal is always to deliver useful, reliable software in a way that empowers the whole team.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Worked on a global team of engineers support coworking webapps. Working on a .NET Framework/.NET Core backend with an AngularJS frontend.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · AngularJS · Microsoft SQL Server · C# · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Software Management · Software Infrastructure · Engineering Management · E-Commerce

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Lead a team of 2-3 software engineers and 1 QA engineer to deliver new functionality for ProductPlan's Integrations and APIs.

Work with Product Management and UX Design to prioritize features and to provide documentation and tickets with enough details for engineers to be successful.

Managed the teams execution, communicated status and renegotiated scope as issues were encountered.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Full Stack Engineer working on a Ruby on Rails Backend, React Frontend and a smidge of Serverless applications in AWS.

positions.title: Software Engineer In Test
positions.description: Worked on a team with 3-5 software engineers to manually test deliverables, as well as provide code review for unit and automated end to end test. Help with maintenance of the automation suite as well as write new tests to improve test coverage.

positions.title: Business Process Analyst
positions.description:
Work with Technical Operations teams to support and develop business processes such as Change Management, Incident Management and Problem Management.

Develop tools and automation to help successful rollout of processes using Python, AWS SAM and Groovy/Javascript (in JIRA).

positions.title: Technical Operations Process Architect
positions.description:
Worked with teams in Technical Operations to continuously improve as well as document Service Request, Incident and Problem Management, with an end goal of adopting ITIL Best Practices.

Implemented and rolled out a new Service Catalog using JIRA Service Desk as well as working with teams to develop their own JIRA configurations.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
Worked with software development teams across all business units to enable fast and efficient delivery of product.

Reported KPIs to leadership teams and often worked as a ScrumMaster and Agile Coach for development teams.

positions.title: Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance
positions.description:
Led a team of 5-10 Quality Assurance Engineers, testing the Remote Support Business Unit. Responsible for coordinating and reporting the efforts of the teams testing GoToAssist Corporate and GoToAssist Remote Support.

Handled all aspects of management for my team including compensation, career growth and performance management.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Lone Quality Assurance Engineer working with a team of developers at CA Headquarters in Islandia, NY on Unicenter Patch Management.

Responsible for test planning and execution as well as configuration and maintenance of test servers running Unicenter Asset Management, Unicenter Software Delivery and Microsoft SQL Server.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Worked as the Test Lead for GoToAssist Corporate. Responsible for writing all test cases for the product and coordinating the efforts of 1-3 Junior QA Team Members across the Software Development Lifecycle.
